levels.name: The First Flame
levels.description: Start with nothing: mine gold, then defend your miners.

tutorial.text: Your miners dig gold from the ore piles and carry it back to your statue. Watch your gold at the top.
Enemies will rush your miners soon. When you have 50 gold, tap the Ember Squire button to build a defender.
Troops hold near your statue by default. Press ATTACK to send everyone at the enemy.
Press DEFEND to pull your army back to protect your statue and miners. You can switch any time.
GARRISON hides your whole army inside the statue. Use it when a big rush comes, then come back out.
Army dying, or winning? Tap the SPEARS button to rain spears from your statue onto the enemy. It recharges.
Switch back to DEFEND or ATTACK, keep your miners alive, and destroy the enemy statue!

levels.name: Broken Frontier
levels.description: Enemies push toward you. Use the defend command.

tutorial.text: Enemy troops will march on your statue. Stay on DEFEND to fight near your walls, then ATTACK when you have the upper hand.

levels.name: Archer's Ridge
levels.description: Ranged units strike from a distance.

tutorial.text: Ash Archers shoot from far away. Keep them behind your front line and they will do the damage safely.

levels.name: Emberfall Pass

tutorial.text: Ember Burst blasts the biggest cluster of enemies. Tap it when enemies are grouped together.
